kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: A judge halted D.C. golf course renovations. Trump says they'll still start next month
wire.summary: A federal judge has barred the government from clearing more trees or making other alterations to D.C.'s East Potomac Park without proper notice. Trump says his administration will appeal.

wire.title: Bolsonaro's party accepts Brazil election defeat, but he refuses to concede
wire.summary: Brazil's opposition party accepts President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's election victory, but Flávio Bolsonaro won't concede, while President Trump calls the vote "rigged" without offering evidence.

wire.title: Discursive Verses: Jay-Z, the Super Bowl and playing with house money
wire.summary: NPR Music culture critic and reporter Rodney Carmichael ruminates on the latest in rap culture. This week: Is the rap mogul's self-selection a crowning achievement or a final affront?

wire.title: A 'Green Army' is out to thwart El Niño flooding
wire.summary: In Nairobi, a city prone to floods, workers in the "Green Army" are making preparations to prevent disaster when El Niño arrives.

wire.title: Democrats have a midterm edge, poll shows. And, Israelis vote in high-stakes election
wire.summary: Democrats are still holding a slight edge with Election Day a week away, according to a new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll. And, Israelis are casting their votes in an election that could change leadership.

wire.title: How Aldi is pushing down grocery prices
wire.summary: The German-owned chain's low prices are winning over shoppers — and pushing competitors to respond.

wire.title: Polymarket has investigated 'dozens' of election-related cases
wire.summary: The prediction market has hired a former FBI official to make sure political insiders don't use the platform for profit from confidential election information.

wire.title: Can Black voting power and Trump fatigue break Mississippi's red wall?
wire.summary: Mississippi has the largest proportional Black population in the country. It's one reason the U.S. Senate race has seen millions in last-minute spending and high-profile campaign visits.

wire.title: Democrats still poised to make gains, but poll shows warning signs for just how many
wire.summary: Democrats hold significant advantages going into Election Day, according to a new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll. But lagging enthusiasm among key groups is just one indicator that gains may not come easy.

wire.title: Morning news brief
wire.summary: A new NPR poll reveals Democrats' advantage going into Election Day, congressional Democrats are forming a task force to protect the election, Netanyahu vies for reelection as polls open in Israel.

wire.title: Flávio Bolsonaro's passports cancelled after he fails to surrender them
wire.summary: The defeated presidential candidate is under investigation for alleged money laundering and barred from leaving Brazil.

wire.title: Turnout so far highest on record as Israelis vote in pivotal election
wire.summary: The elections - the first since the Hamas-led attacks on Israel and the wars which followed - are widely seen as a referendum on Benjamin Netanyahu.

wire.title: Norway and Finland leaders hold rare call with Putin
wire.summary: This is the first time European leaders have had direct communication with Russia's president in more than a year.

wire.title: Truce begins in Ukraine city where residents ate weeds to survive
wire.summary: The Oleshky ceasefire, which the White House said was secured by US First Lady Melania Trump, is meant to allow aid to get in and civilians to get out.

wire.title: Ballon d'Or ceremony raises case of French sports journalist jailed in Algeria
wire.summary: He is in jail accused of supporting terrorism after travelling to the politically sensitive region Kabylie.

wire.title: Mbappé sorry for 'ill-judged' Mao remark after backlash in China
wire.summary: The France star had referred to the former Chinese leader as a "dictator" during an interview about memes.
